18901.commentary: (MNa) bilaṃ olaggeyyun'ti koṭṭhāsaṃ laggāpeyyuṃ, iminā satthadhammaṃ nāma dasseti. satthavāho kira mahākantārapaṭipanno antarāmagge goṇe mate maṃsaṃ gahetvā sabbesaṃ satthikānaṃ idaṃ khāditvā ettakaṃ mūlaṃ dātabban'ti koṭṭhāsaṃ olaggeti, goṇamaṃsaṃ nāma khādantāpi atthi akhādantāpi, mūlaṃ dātuṃ sakkontā'pi asakkontā'pi. satthavāho yena mūlena goṇo gahito, tassa nikkhaman'atthaṃ sabbesaṃ balakkārena koṭṭhāsaṃ datvā mūlaṃ gaṇhāti, ayaṃ satthadhammo. evam'evaṃ brāhmaṇā'pi lokassa paṭiññaṃ aggahetvā attano'va dhammatāya catasso pāricariyā paññapentīti dassetuṃ evam'eva kho'ti-ādim'āha. (ANa) akāmakassa bilaṃ olaggeyyun'ti satthe gacchamāne goṇamhi mate gomaṃsamūlaṃ uppādan'atthāya vibhajitvā khādamānā ekassa gomaṃsaṃ anicchantasseva koṭṭhāsaṃ katvā ayañ'ca te khāditabbo, mūlañ'ca dātabban'ti taṃ koṭṭhāsasaṅkhātaṃ bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ, balakkārena hatthe ṭhapeyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiko, tassa akāmakassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, maṃsañ'ca khāditabbaṃ, mūlañ'ca anuppadātabban'ti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo paṭaliyo upāhanā ārohitvā khaggaṃ olaggetvā chattena dhāriyamānena aggadvārena assamaṃ pavisitvā te isayo sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme apabyāmato karitvā atikkami.

18904.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from olaṅgheti, caus

examples.text: āmasanā, parāmasanā, omasanā, ummasanā, olaṅghanā, ullaṅghanā, ākaḍḍhanā, patikaḍḍhanā, abhiniggaṇhanā, abhinippīḷanā, gahaṇaṃ, chupanaṃ.
ambho, rukkha, pubbe tvaṃ olambakaṃ otārento viya ujukam'eva phalāni pātesi

18910.commentary: (MNa) olambantī'ti upaṭṭhahanti. sesapadadvayaṃ tass'eva vevacanaṃ, olamban'ādi-ākārena hi tāni upaṭṭhahanti, tasmā evaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāyaṃ vā semānaṃ, yāni'ssa pubbe pāpakāni kammāni katāni kāyena duccaritāni vācāya duccaritāni manasā duccaritāni tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
ath'eko lolamakkaṭo rukkhā otaritvā tassa piṭṭhiṃ abhiruhitvā uccārapassāvaṃ katvā siṅge gaṇhitvā olambanto naṅguṭṭhe gahetvā dolāyanto'va kīḷi

so kira vesālinagaradvāre ekaṃ kakudharukkhaṃ āruyha dvīhi pādehi rukkhasākhaṃ gaṇhitvā adhosiro olambanto kapilānaṃ me sataṃ detha, kahāpaṇe detha, paricārikaṃ detha, no ce dassatha, ito patitvā maranto nagaraṃ anagaraṃ karissāmī'ti vadati.

18916.meaning2: having hung down, having rested on, having suspended

18920.meaning2: makes hang down, lets hang down; suspends

examples.text: manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā purato'pi pacchato'pi olambentā nivāsessanti, seyyathā'pi gihī kāmabhogino'ti.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kāyappacālakaṃ antaraghare gacchanti kāyaṃ olambentā

18924.commentary: (THIa) aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhin'ti mayhaṃ sīsassa aḍḍham'eva muṇḍemi. keci aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhin'ti kesakalāpassa aḍḍhaṃ jaṭābandhanavasena bandhitvā aḍḍhaṃ vissajjesin'ti atthaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: bahūvatasamādānā, aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhiṃ, chamāya seyyaṃ kappemi, rattiṃ bhattaṃ na bhuñj'ahaṃ.

18925.commentary: (ANa) veṇiṃ olikhitun'ti eḷakalomāni kappetvā vijaṭetvā veṇiṃ kātuṃ.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ piṇḍāya carantā candanikam'pi pavisanti, oligalle'pi papatanti, kaṇṭak'āvāṭam'pi ārohanti, suttam'pi gāviṃ ārohanti, māṇavehi'pi samāgacchanti katakammehi'pi akatakammehi'pi, mātugāmo'pi te asaddhammena nimanteti.

18929.meaning2: hangs down; sinks down, cowers; hangs back; falls behind

examples.text: lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya na chandaṃ janeti, na vāyamati, olīnavuttiko ca hoti sāthaliko.

18931.meaning1: (comm) dripping from the bottom and both sides
18931.meaning2: hanging or dripping down and round about

examples.text: parisā c'assa hoti bāhullikā. laddhaṃ laddhaṃ kolambe'pi ghaṭe'pi pūretvā paṭisāmeti, parissāvanāni'pi thavikāyo'pi pūretvā vātapānesu laggeti. tāni olīnavilīnāni tiṭṭhanti.

18932.meaning1: sluggish in practice; inactive in nature; doing as little as possible
18932.meaning2: liable to hang back; habitually sluggish
18932.commentary: (MNa) olīnavuttiko ca hotī'ti līnajjhāsayo hoti (SNa) gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ patitvā, vālikāya otthaṭabhāvena antarasetu viya hutvā, bahūnaṃ paccayo jātarukkho viya rathavinīta-mahā-ariyavaṃsa-cand'opam'ādi-paṭipadāsu aññataraṃ paṭipadaṃ uggahetvā ṭhito olīnavuttiko puggalo veditabbo.

examples.text: lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya na chandaṃ janeti, na vāyamati, olīnavuttiko ca hoti sāthaliko.

18934.meaning1: gets stuck; lags behind; gets bogged down; grinds to a halt
18934.meaning2: is inactive or sluggish, sticks to, lags behind

examples.text: dvīhi, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigatehi pariyuṭṭhitā devamanussā olīyanti eke, atidhāvanti eke, cakkhumanto ca passanti. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke?

18937.meaning2: was inactive or sluggish, stuck to, lagged behind

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma jarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evam'ev'assu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

18939.meaning1: slipped down and hanging at wrong angles; collapsed and hanging skew
18939.commentary: (MNa) jarasālāya gopānasiyo'ti jiṇṇasālāya gopānasiyo, tā vaṃsato muccitvā maṇḍale patiṭṭhahanti, maṇḍalato muccitvā bhūmiyan'ti, evaṃ ekā upari hoti, ekā heṭṭhā'ti oluggaviluggā bhavanti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma jarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evam'ev'assu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

kiṃ caritassa puggalassa kiṃ sappāyan'ti ettha pana sen'āsanaṃ tāva rāgacaritassa adhotavedikaṃ bhūmaṭṭhakaṃ akatapabbhārakaṃ tiṇakuṭikaṃ paṇṇasāl'ādīnaṃ aññataraṃ raj'okiṇṇaṃ jatukābharitaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ atiuccaṃ vā atinīcaṃ vā ujjaṅgalaṃ sāsaṅkaṃ asucivisamamaggaṃ

18940.meaning1: is breaking down; is falling apart; is collapsing

examples.text: atha kiñ'carahi tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi? sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi, kul'ūpaghātaṃ maññe carasi. olujjati kho te, āvuso ānanda, parisā, palujjanti kho te, āvuso, navappāyā.
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā daṇḍam'olubbha ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi
atha kho āyasmā khemako daṇḍam'olubbha yena therā bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā therehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sammodi.
pattakallan'ti patto kālo imassa olokanassā'ti pattakālaṃ, pattakālam'eva pattakallaṃ.
suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. ayaṃ itthan'nāmo bhikkhu saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kattu'kāmo assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ. so saṅghaṃ kuṭivatthuolokanaṃ yācati.

18945.meaning1: manner of looking; way of checking

18946.meaning2: looks at; watches; observes, examines; regards; looks to; looks down; looks to for permission or instruction
18946.commentary: (JAa) olokayī'ti taṃ kinnarānaṃ bhavanabhūtaṃ pabbataṃ āruyha subhaddāya dinnasaññāvasena heṭṭhā olokesi.

examples.text: āruyha selaṃ bhavanaṃ kinnarānaṃ, olokaya pabbatapādamūlaṃ, atha dakkhasī meghasamānavaṇṇaṃ, nigrodharājaṃ atha sahassapādaṃ.

eko kāko uṭṭhāya tiṭṭha tāv'etassa imasmiṃ rāj'ābhisekakāle evarūpaṃ mukhaṃ bhavati, kuddhassa kīdisaṃ bhavissati, iminā hi kuddhena olokitā mayaṃ tattakapāle pakkhittaloṇaṃ viya tattha tatth'eva bhijjissāma, imaṃ rājānaṃ kātuṃ mayhaṃ na ruccatī'ti

18951.meaning1: should be looked (at); should be examined; should be checked

examples.text: na ujjhānasaññinā paresaṃ patto oloketabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca ujjhānasaññī paresaṃ pattaṃ oloketi, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

18952.commentary: (MNa) naṭṭhaṃ kākaṇikaṃ vā māsakaṃ vā pariyesanto viya na adho oloketi

examples.text: apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyen'eva apaloketi, so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi, na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañ'ca pekkhati, tato c'assa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
na ujjhānasaññī paresaṃ pattaṃ olokessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

sace sabbo saṅgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, sabbena saṅghena oloketabbaṃ. no ce sabbo saṅgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, ye tattha honti bhikkhū byattā paṭibalā sārambhaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ aparikkamanaṃ jānituṃ te yācitvā sammannitabbā.

18954.meaning1: having looked; having observed; having noticed; having checked

examples.text: so gehā nikkhamitvā… akkhīni me dhūmāyantī'ti vatvā nalāṭe hatthaṃ ṭhapetvā uddhaṃ oloketvā, aho dukkhaṃ, ayyo no mahākassapatthero cirassaṃ me kuṭidvāraṃ āgato, atthi nu kho kiñci gehe'ti āha
tasmiṃ samaye catusattatisahassajaṭilā paṇītapaṇītāni ojavantāni phal'āphalāni gahetvā ācariyassa santikaṃ sampattā buddhānañ'c'eva ācariyassa ca nisinnāsanaṃ oloketvā āhaṃsu.
okkhittacakkhunā antaraghare gantabbaṃ yugamattaṃ pekkhantena. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca tahaṃ tahaṃ olokento antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
bodhisatto ito c'ito ca olokento kañci adisvā vegena uṭṭhāya pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ān'āpāne pariggahetvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ nibbattesi.

18957.commentary: (MNa) puṭ'osenā'pī'ti puṭ'osaṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ. taṃ pātheyyaṃ gahetvā'pi upasaṅkamituṃ yuttam'evā'ti attho. puṭ'aṃsenā'ti'pi pāṭho, tass'attho puṭo aṃse assā'ti puṭ'aṃso, tena puṭ'aṃsena, aṃse pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenā'pī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sutaṃ kho pana m'etaṃ, yassa rañño cakkavattissa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkati ṭhānā cavati, na dāni tena raññā ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ hotī'ti.

18962.commentary: (DNa) osakkantiyā vā ussakkeyyā'ti paṭikkamantiyā upagaccheyya, anicchantiyā iccheyya, ekāya sampayogaṃ anicchantiyā eko iccheyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma osakkantiyā vā ussakkeyya, parammukhiṃ vā āliṅgeyya, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi, kiñ'hi paro parassa karissatī'ti.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, so puriso bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ
nāsāyaṃ suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya. daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷetvā osajjeyya.

atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo rañño māgadhassa ajātasattuno vedehiputtassa sabbaṃ hatthikāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ assakāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ rathakāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ pattikāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā jīvantam'eva naṃ osajji.
te suṇanti, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā osaṭo'ti. te yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkamanti.
tena kho pana samayena goliyāni nāma bhikkhu āraññiko padasamācāro saṅghamajjhe osaṭo hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

atha kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi

18981.commentary: (MNa) osadhitārakā'ti sukkatārakā. sā hi yasmā tassā udayato paṭṭhāya tena saññāṇena osadhāni gaṇhanti'pi pivanti'pi, tasmā osadhitārakā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma osadhitārakā odātā odātavaṇṇā odātanidassanā odātanibhāsā, seyyathā'pi vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ odātaṃ odātavaṇṇaṃ odātanidassanaṃ odātanibhāsaṃ, evam'eva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni.

18990.meaning1: having come down (to); having wandered down (to); having arrived (at)

examples.text: tesaṃ'y'eva kho, vāseṭṭha, sattānaṃ ekacce sattā araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu taṃ jhānaṃ anabhisambhuṇamānā gāmasāmantaṃ nigamasāmantaṃ osaritvā ganthe karontā acchanti.

padaṃ nāma ekato paṭṭhapetvā ekato osāpenti. anupadaṃ nāma pāṭekkaṃ paṭṭhapetvā ekato osāpenti. anvakkharaṃ nāma, rūpaṃ aniccan'ti vuccamāno, run'ti opāteti. anubyañjanaṃ nāma rūpaṃ aniccan'ti vuccamāno, vedanā aniccā'ti saddaṃ nicchāreti.

18999.meaning2: projection to a house or building, verandah
